test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Suraj can complete a certain work in the same time in which Manoj and Rajesh together can complete it. If Rajesh can alone complete it in 28 days and Suraj and Manoj together can complete it in 14 days, then in how many days can Manoj alone complete it?
solution:
Given:

Time taken by Suraj = time taken by Manoj + Rajesh

Time taken by Rajesh = 28 days

Time taken by Suraj and Manoj together = 14 days

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

Calculation:

Let total work be 28 units [As LCM of 14, 28 is 28]

So, efficiency of Rajesh (R) = 28/28 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of Suraj and Manoj (S + M) = 28/14 

⇒ S + M = 2 units/day

According to the question,

Efficiency of Suraj = Efficiency of Manoj + Rajesh

⇒ S = M + 1

⇒ S + M = M + 1 + M

⇒ 2 = 2M + 1

⇒ 2 - 1 = 2M

⇒ 1 = 2M

⇒ M= 0.5

So, the efficiency of Manoj = 0.5

Required Time = 28/0.5

⇒ 56 days.

**∴ Manoj alone completes it in 56 days.**
